link_rules: If topic is service/treatment-related, link that specific page. Otherwise, use location page URLs.
cta_rules: At least one call-to-action must be present. No specific wording required.

tone.description: Professional, clinical, and compassionate — focused on mental health and neurological wellness

writing_style.title_capitalization: Use AP Style title case. Example: 'How To Know if You Need Psychiatry or Therapy in [Location]'

terminology.conditions: Include all conditions treated by NeuroWellness Spa whenever possible

writing_style.bullet_points: Always use sentence casing for bullet points. Example: 'Prolonged sadness or emotional numbness' (not 'Prolonged Sadness Or Emotional Numbness')
rules: Bullet points must use sentence casing (capitalize first word only)
Include all conditions treated whenever possible

valid_topic_sources: Awareness days/holidays (topic must be closely related to the post content)

tms_guidelines.accuracy_rule: TMS is FDA-approved for depression (including treatment-resistant depression). It is also used as an off-label approach for anxiety, OCD, PTSD, and ADHD. Never state TMS is FDA-approved for conditions other than depression.
tms_guidelines.sacramento_exception: TMS therapy is NOT available at the Sacramento location — do not mention TMS for Sacramento posts

rules: MUST mention that online services are available
Must NOT mention or reference TMS therapy

general.description: All posts follow the same core guidelines. Apply location-specific rules where applicable.

allowed: Therapy session imagery relevant to the post
not_allowed: Addiction or medicine-specific images (pills, syringes, bottles)
Images depicting physical contact with minors (hugs, hand on shoulder, similar gestures)
image_guidelines.important_note: Physical contact with minors in images is a documented cause of GBP post rejections.

formatting_rules: Post must include a relevant link
Post must contain at least one CTA
Bullet points must use sentence casing
